She performs controlled vertical pulldown repetitions while maintaining a steady posture. The gym floor is covered in dark grey rubber mats, and other weightlifting stacks are visible in the background. (3) The scene cuts to a frontal view where she is preparing for a deadlift. She bends down to grip a weighted barbell with silver plates. She wears black wrist straps for better grip. Her facial expression is focused and determined. An air conditioner and health-related posters are visible on the white wall behind her. (4) She executes a Romanian deadlift seen from a side profile. She lowers the barbell towards her shins with a flat back and then returns to a standing position. A glass door with Chinese signage and various power racks are seen in the surrounding gym environment. (5) From a low-angle back view, she performs squats or lunges with the barbell. Her legs are spread wide as she lowers her hips. A black metal rack with the text 'NO FEAR' is clearly visible. The lighting remains bright and uniform throughout the space. (6) She moves to a back extension apparatus, lying prone to lift her upper body repeatedly. Finally, she is lying on a pink yoga mat on the floor using a foam roller under her neck. She looks directly into the camera and smiles broadly, showing her face and relaxed posture.
